definition: Average what-if response across countries: the mean, over the countries observed in the panel's last year, of the change in the forecast median of each target after a large move in one node (its latest value moved by 0.5 standard deviations of its level), up ('shocks') or down ('shocks_fall'); p10 / p90 keys give the spread across countries. From the forecaster of record, each horizon forecast directly. A statement about prediction, not a causal effect. Units: SD of the target's level.

stability.mode: not applicable: each horizon is forecast directly

method: mean over countries of what-if responses from the forecaster of record
